metadata.method_name: cross-family solver consensus (c_score_align) vs LLM judge on R_COMP FREE
metadata.description: Iteration-5 confirmation attempt of criterion (c). Scores sealed before labels; labels from the dataset-5 labeller resumed once; the gloss gate failed twice -> FALLBACK B -> NOT_TESTABLE. Predict_* are metric scores (higher = more likely ERROR). output = the sealed final label.

examples.input: {"text": "Each legislator who is at Board Game night, who visits a coffee shop regularly, and who can distinguish the taste of different condiments is Emily's friend, except if the legislator is an elected official.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Legislator(x) ∧ At(x, boardGameNight) ∧ RegularlyVisits(x, coffeeShop) ∧ CanDistinguish(x, differentCondiments)) → (Friend(x, emily) ∧ ¬ElectedOfficial(x)))", "template_id": "T1"}

{"text": "Any certified public accountant that lives in California and that does not play a lot of chess is born in New York City, provided that the certified public accountant loses time and works from home.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((CertifiedPublicAccountant(x) ∧ LivesIn(x, california) ∧ ¬PlayLotsOf(x, chess) ∧ LoseTime(x) ∧ WorkFromHome(x)) → BornIn(x, newYorkCity))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "If an adult will be late for work and is invited to join the club, and the adult also does not steal government funds, then the adult is always tired in the morning, except when the adult loves the opera.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Adult(x) ∧ WillBeLateForWork(x) ∧ InvitedToJoin(x, club) ∧ ¬StealGovernmentFunds(x)) → (∀y (Morning(y) → Tired(x, y)) ∧ ¬(Love(x, opera) → Tired(x, y))))", "template_id": "T2"}

{"text": "Except when the device is sold at Apple Stores, every device that is for reading and that is used primarily for media consumption is in French, provided that the device is supported by legs.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Device(x) ∧ (ForReading(x) ∧ PrimarilyForMediaConsumption(x)) ∧ ¬SoldAt(x, appleStores) ∧ SupportedByLegs(x)) → InLanguage(x, french))", "template_id": "T6"}

{"text": "Except when the wetland is designed for high-performance calculations, every wetland that is under stress and that is for reading can help slow down global warming, provided that the wetland is covered in sugar.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Wetland(x) ∧ (UnderStress(x) ∧ ForReading(x)) ∧ ¬DesignedForHighPerformance(x)) → (CoveredInSugar(x) → HelpSlowDownGlobalWarming(x)))", "template_id": "T6"}

{"text": "Every astronomical object that is used primarily for communication and that has won an Oscar is grass, providing that the astronomical object has sold a large number of copies and is covered in sugar.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((AstronomicalObject(x) ∧ UsedPrimarilyFor(x, communication) ∧ WonOscar(x) ∧ SoldLargeNumber(x) ∧ CoveredIn(x, sugar)) → Grass(x))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "Anybody who is an elected official, can get the rhythms right, and attends the conference in person lives in a cold place unless they are always tired in the morning.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((ElectedOfficial(x) ∧ CanGetRhythmsRight(x) ∧ AttendsInPerson(x, conference)) → (LivesInColdPlace(x) ⊕ AlwaysTiredInMorning(x)))", "template_id": "T7"}

{"text": "Every American Airlines aircraft that is food and that makes tea has been adapted from its original version, providing that the American Airlines aircraft is displayed on the homepage and has a high carbohydrate content.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Aircraft(x) ∧ AmericanAirlines(x) ∧ Food(x) ∧ MakesTea(x)) → (AdaptedFromOriginal(x) ∧ DisplayedOnHomepage(x) ∧ HighCarbohydrateContent(x)))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "When a professional basketball player is one of Emily's friends and has a flexible schedule, and the professional basketball player also works full-time, the professional basketball player can get the rhythms right, except when the professional basketball player enjoys state ownership of means of production.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Friend(x, emily) ∧ ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ FlexibleSchedule(x) ∧ WorkFullTime(x)) → (CanGetRhythmsRight(x) ⊕ Enjoy(x, stateOwnershipOfMeansOfProduction)))", "template_id": "T2"}

{"text": "When a planet is read by Tomas and has a high carbohydrate content, and the planet also is played by bowing, the planet can be displayed on electronic devices, except when the planet has cherry-picked data.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((ReadBy(x, tomas) ∧ HighCarbContent(x) ∧ PlayedBy(x, bowing)) ∧ ¬CherryPicked(x) → CanBeDisplayedOn(x, electronicDevices))", "template_id": "T2"}

{"text": "Any mobile phone that is not made from grain and that requires frequent watering is written by Tolkien, provided that the mobile phone has two conductive plates and emits low levels of pollutants.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((MobilePhone(x) ∧ ¬MadeFrom(x, grain) ∧ RequireFrequentWatering(x)) ∧ Has(x, twoConductivePlates) ∧ Emissions(x, lowPollutants) → WrittenBy(x, tolkien))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "If a centerback player is bad at chess, is criticized by their boss, and does not publish journals, then the centerback player has a relaxed schedule, but only if the centerback player is a young working professional.", "candidate_fol": "(∃x (Centerback(x) ∧ BadAt(x, chess) ∧ CriticizedBy(x, boss) ∧ ¬Publishes(x, journal)) → (RelaxedSchedule(x) ∧ (Centerback(x) ∧ YoungWorkingProfessional(x))))", "template_id": "T8"}

{"text": "Every cell that has high engagement metrics, that is made from grain, and that has a flat surface is an area of land saturated with water, unless the cell is used in the lab computer.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Cell(x) ∧ HighEngagementMetrics(x) ∧ MadeFromGrain(x) ∧ FlatSurface(x)) → (AreaOfLandSaturatedWithWater(x) ⊕ ¬UsedInLabComputer(x)))", "template_id": "T1"}

{"text": "Any Bulbophyllum that freezes food and that has minimal environmental impact during production is written by Tolkien, provided that the Bulbophyllum is an evergreen tree and is in Size Town.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Bulbophyllum(x) ∧ FreezeFood(x) ∧ MinimalEnvironmentalImpact(x)) → (WrittenBy(x, tolkien) ∧ EvergreenTree(x) ∧ In(x, sizeTown)))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "Any habitat that has the company logo and that is in an urban area is a social media application, provided that the habitat produces sound by vibrating strings and has video features.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Habitat(x) ∧ Has(x, companyLogo) ∧ In(x, urbanArea) ∧ ProducesSound(x, vibratingStrings) ∧ Has(x, videoFeatures)) → SocialMediaApplication(x))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "Every commercial vessel that has a supermassive black hole at its center, that is written by Tolkien, and that has a wooden body is interactive, unless the commercial vessel stores energy in an electric field.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((CommercialVessel(x) ∧ Has(x, supermassiveBlackHole, center) ∧ WrittenBy(x, tolkien) ∧ WoodenBody(x)) → (Interactive(x) ⊕ StoresEnergy(x, electricField)))", "template_id": "T1"}

{"text": "If a museum ship is electronic and has a hollow body, and the museum ship also is not deemed reliable, then the museum ship has been adapted from its original version, except when the museum ship has minimal environmental impact during production.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((MuseumShip(x) ∧ Electronic(x) ∧ HollowBody(x) ∧ ¬Reliable(x)) → (AdaptedFromOriginal(x) ⊕ MinimalEnvironmentalImpact(x, production)))", "template_id": "T2"}

{"text": "Every photographer who commits a crime, who lives in a large city, and who has a talent of cooking is born in New York City, unless the photographer takes more than normal financial risks.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Photographer(x) ∧ CommitCrime(x) ∧ LivesIn(x, largeCity) ∧ HasTalent(x, cooking)) → (BornIn(x, newYorkCity) ⊕ TakesMoreThanNormalFinancialRisks(x)))", "template_id": "T1"}

{"text": "If a professional basketball player has a relaxed schedule, is one of Michael's neighbors, and is not American, then the professional basketball player has a temporary role at the orchestra, but only if the professional basketball player works regularly.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ HasRelaxedSchedule(x) ∧ NeighborOf(x, michael) ∧ ¬American(x)) → (HasTemporaryRoleAt(x, orchestra) ∧ RegularlyWorks(x) → HasTemporaryRoleAt(x, orchestra)))", "template_id": "T8"}

{"text": "Each digital interactive artwork that freezes food and that is formed by volcanic activity is made in Maranello, provided that the digital interactive artwork is worn for various occasions or purposes, except if the digital interactive artwork is by Phoenix.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((DigitalInteractiveArtwork(x) ∧ Freeze(x, food) ∧ FormedBy(x, volcanicActivity)) → (MadeIn(x, maranello) → (WornFor(x, variousOccasions) ∨ WornFor(x, variousPurposes)) ∧ ¬By(x, phoenix)))", "template_id": "T5"}

{"text": "A singer who does not attend the conference in person and who steals government funds makes a lot of money as long as the singer is truly innocent, unless the singer contributes to the country.", "candidate_fol": "(∃x (Singer(x) ∧ ¬AttendInPerson(x, conference) ∧ StealGovernmentFunds(x) ∧ TrulyInnocent(x) → MakeALotOfMoney(x)) ∧ (∃x (Singer(x) ∧ ContributeToCountry(x)) → ¬MakeALotOfMoney(x)))", "template_id": "T4"}

{"text": "No epic drama that possesses adequate processing power, that orbits around a star, and that is not changing is unstable, unless the epic drama is under stress.", "candidate_fol": "∀x (EpicDrama(x) ∧ (AdequateProcessingPower(x) ∧ OrbitsAroundStar(x) ∧ ¬Changing(x)) → (Unstable(x) ⊕ (UnderStress(x))))", "template_id": "T9"}

{"text": "Every ardent communist that does not have early-morning habits and that has committed a crime is stung by a stonefish, providing that the ardent communist works at a pool and is good at planning.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((ArdentCommunist(x) ∧ ¬HasEarlyMorningHabits(x) ∧ HasCommittedCrime(x)) → (WorksAtPool(x) ∧ GoodAtPlanning(x) → StungBy(x, stonefish)))", "template_id": "T3"}

{"text": "Each award-winning novelist who is not sentenced to a punishment and who is a citizen of Lawton Park is in chemical endangerment, provided that the award-winning novelist is harmful, except if the award-winning novelist is male.", "candidate_fol": "∀x (AwardWinningNovelist(x) ∧ ¬SentencedToPunishment(x) ∧ CitizenOf(x, lawtonPark) → (Harmful(x) → ChemicalEndangerment(x)) ∧ ¬Male(x))", "template_id": "T5"}

{"text": "Each tablet that is not by Phoenix, that is in Size Town, and that rises prominently above its surroundings involves competition against another team, except if the tablet orbits a star.", "candidate_fol": "∀x ((Tablet(x) ∧ ¬By(x, phoenix) ∧ In(x, sizeTown) ∧ RisesProminently(x) ∧ Above(x, surroundings)) → (∃y (Team(y) ∧ CompetesAgainst(x, y) ∧ ¬Orbits(x, star)))", "template_id": "T1"}
